text: Select: activities.activity_id, activities.standard_value, activities.standard_units, activities.standard_relation, activities.standard_type, compound_structures.canonical_smiles, compound_structures.molfile. Source: activities, assays, compound_structures. Join: activities.assay_id = assays.assay_id AND activities.molregno = compound_structures.molregno. Filter: assays.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1040694'.
